info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Peridot Racket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Peridot Racket Detail Management API allows users to efficiently create and manage detailed entries for the Peridot Racket catalog. This API is essential for vendors and developers who need to input comprehensive product information, including specifications, pricing, and availability. It streamlines the cataloging process, ensuring that all racket details are consistently captured and updated. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems looking to enhance their product listings.

post.summary: Create a new Peridot Racket detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail entry for a Peridot Racket. Ensure to provide all necessary information in the request body to successfully add the new detail.

requestBody.description: A request body containing the details for the Peridot Racket. This should include all necessary attributes required for the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.
